about_the_game:
Escape the Plate!

In the year of 2035, Earth was starting to see some big changes. Technology was advancing faster than ever, people were healthier, happier. Pollution levels were at their lowest levels. Just about everything seemed to be heading in the right direction finally. Some people even referred to it as a utopia.

One thing happened however, that still to this day, we have no answers for... Animals started dying. More specifically farm animals. Cattle, pig, lamb. No one could find out why. Eventually, this led to people relying more and more on fruits and vegetables. Indirectly, people got healthier. A lot of people said maybe it was for the best.

There is, of course always, two sides to every story...

Our Heroes Unite

Trapped in a sinister food processing facility, three unlikely heroes, a fiery tomato, a brainy ear of corn, and a tough-as-nails cabbage, must team up to escape their culinary fate. Use each veggie’s unique abilities to solve puzzles, dodge deadly machinery, and outwit the kitchen crew in this quirky, fast-paced adventure. Will you make it out of the factory or end up on a plate?

short_description: Three plucky vegetables must escape a deadly processing plant! Use each hero’s unique abilities to solve puzzles, avoid hazards, and fight for your freedom before you’re served for dinner.
